// Prints TypeScript's inbox text and JSON for each row of rust-inbox
// "Inbox cursor equals TypeScript's" and "Inbox JSON equals TypeScript's".
// Run from the repository root after `pnpm build`:
//   node print-inbox-goldens.mjs <inbox crate tests folder> <json-records fixture> <golden folder>
// Each case makes a fresh scratch base folder holding `checkout`, a copy of the
// case's fixture, and `home`, an empty home folder. The inbox is
// `readInbox(checkout, { config, now: 2026-10-24T12:00:00.000Z, home })` with
// `DEFAULT_CONFIG`, or with `vcs.enabled` and `vcs.author`
// `osq <osq@example.com>` for the records case. The text is `formatInboxText`
// of it and the JSON is `JSON.stringify(inbox, null, 2)`, each followed by one
// newline, as `osq` and `osq --json` print them; the running lock's pid is
// replaced by `<pid>`.
//
// The `cursor` case writes `<home>/.osq/last-look/<sha256 of the checkout's
// real path>.json` holding `{"lastLook":"2026-10-01T10:00:00.000Z"}` first.
//
// The `records` setup, in order: `git init -b main` in the checkout, commits by
// `osq <osq@example.com>` of every file but
// `openspec/changes/archive/033-wait`, a worktree `<base>/worktree` on a new
// branch `osq/033-wait` that adds that folder in one commit, then
// `openspec/changes/030-run/.run/running/1.pid` holding
// `{"pid":<a live pid>,"startedAt":1792843075000}` (125 seconds before now) and
// `<home>/.osq/watch/<sha256 of the checkout's real path>/after-land.json`
// holding `{"change":"035-gone","command":"pnpm build","exitCode":1,"failedAt":"2026-10-24T11:00:00.000Z"}`.
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import os from 'node:os';
import path from 'node:path';
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';

const dist = (file) => pathToFileURL(path.resolve('dist', file)).href;
const { DEFAULT_CONFIG } = await import(dist('core/foundation/config.js'));
const { readInbox } = await import(dist('core/status/inbox-projection.js'));
const { formatInboxText } = await import(dist('core/status/inbox-text.js'));

const [tests, records, golden] = process.argv.slice(2);
const NOW = new Date('2026-10-24T12:00:00.000Z');
const WAIT = path.join('openspec', 'changes', 'archive', '033-wait');
const GIT_ENV = {
  GIT_AUTHOR_NAME: 'osq',
  GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL: 'osq@example.com',
  GIT_COMMITTER_NAME: 'osq',
  GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL: 'osq@example.com',
};

function git(cwd, ...args) {
  const run = spawnSync('git', args, { cwd, encoding: 'utf8', env: { ...process.env, ...GIT_ENV } });
  if (run.status !== 0) throw new Error(`git ${args.join(' ')}: ${run.stderr}`);
}

function write(file, text) {
  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(file), { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(file, text);
}

function rootHash(root) {
  return createHash('sha256').update(fs.realpathSync(root), 'utf8').digest('hex');
}

function cursor(base) {
  const root = path.join(base, 'checkout');
  write(
    path.join(base, 'home', '.osq', 'last-look', `${rootHash(root)}.json`),
    '{"lastLook":"2026-10-01T10:00:00.000Z"}\n',
  );
}

function recordsSetup(base) {
  const root = path.join(base, 'checkout');
  const wt = path.join(base, 'worktree');
  const keep = path.join(base, 'keep');
  fs.renameSync(path.join(root, WAIT), keep);
  git(root, 'init', '-q', '-b', 'main');
  git(root, 'add', '-A');
  git(root, 'commit', '-q', '-m', 'all');
  git(root, 'worktree', 'add', '-q', '-b', 'osq/033-wait', wt);
  fs.cpSync(keep, path.join(wt, WAIT), { recursive: true });
  fs.rmSync(keep, { recursive: true, force: true });
  git(wt, 'add', '-A');
  git(wt, 'commit', '-q', '-m', 'archive 033');
  write(
    path.join(root, 'openspec', 'changes', '030-run', '.run', 'running', '1.pid'),
    `{"pid":${process.pid},"startedAt":1792843075000}`,
  );
  write(
    path.join(base, 'home', '.osq', 'watch', rootHash(root), 'after-land.json'),
    '{"change":"035-gone","command":"pnpm build","exitCode":1,"failedAt":"2026-10-24T11:00:00.000Z"}\n',
  );
}

const VCS = {
  ...DEFAULT_CONFIG,
  vcs: { ...DEFAULT_CONFIG.vcs, enabled: true, author: 'osq <osq@example.com>' },
};

const cases = [
  { name: 'repo', fixture: path.join(tests, 'golden', 'repo'), setup: () => {}, config: DEFAULT_CONFIG },
  { name: 'repo-cursor', fixture: path.join(tests, 'golden', 'repo'), setup: cursor, config: DEFAULT_CONFIG },
  { name: 'records', fixture: records, setup: recordsSetup, config: VCS },
];

for (const c of cases) {
  const base = fs.realpathSync(fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'osq-inbox-json-')));
  const root = path.join(base, 'checkout');
  const home = path.join(base, 'home');
  fs.mkdirSync(home);
  fs.cpSync(c.fixture, root, { recursive: true });
  c.setup(base);
  const inbox = await readInbox(root, { config: c.config, now: NOW, home });
  const pid = (text) => text.split(`"pid": ${process.pid}`).join('"pid": <pid>');
  const json = pid(`${JSON.stringify(inbox, null, 2)}\n`);
  if (json.includes(base)) throw new Error(`${c.name}: JSON names the scratch base`);
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(golden, `${c.name}.json`), json);
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(golden, `${c.name}.txt`), `${formatInboxText(inbox)}\n`);
  fs.rmSync(base, { recursive: true, force: true });
}
